summary: The customer called to close their account due to poor service and monthly delays. The agent expressed sympathy, asked for the account number, checked the account, and successfully processed the closure request quickly, leaving the customer very satisfied.

compliance_flags.description: The agent proceeded to discuss account details and process an account closure without performing any identity verification steps.

evidence.text: ولا مهندس، بحزنني كتير أسمع هالحكي وأكيد رح نشوف شو السبب، ممكن بس تعطيني رقم الحساب؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: While polite and helpful, the agent used unprofessional slang ('ولا مهندس') in a customer service context.
